Messages.Author: Santi Jean-Pierre
Messages.Body:
I'm sure you know about this auspex combat card:

"aus: dodge
AUS: only usable by the acting vampire after the opposing minion has chosen
his or her strike. Cancel this actig vampire's strike and choose a new one".

The "acting vampire" is your vampire, right ? So, basically I could choose
to deal a basic strike and then, seeing my opponent doesn't dodge, play
primal instincts to change my mind and play a card inflicting aggravated
damage (I'm playing Tzimisce). Am I correct ?

Could I use this card to cancel my opponent's strike ? (I suppose I couldn't
but it doesn't hurt asking ;) ). And, in case it's not possible do you know
about a card a Tzimisce could play to cancel his enemy's strike ?

Thanks

one".
>

choose
> to deal a basic strike and then, seeing my opponent doesn't dodge,
play
> primal instincts to change my mind and play a card inflicting
aggravated
> damage (I'm playing Tzimisce). Am I correct ?

Yup. Too bad Primal insticts is terribly expensive and Tzim's aren't
exactly known for their surplus of blood.
Now, if you're playing it in a Theft/BoS-like deck, it'd be a good
addition, but then, Thoughts Betrayed is superior.

> Could I use this card to cancel my opponent's strike ? (I suppose I
couldn't
> but it doesn't hurt asking ;) ).

Nope.

>And, in case it's not possible do you know
> about a card a Tzimisce could play to cancel his enemy's strike ?

Skin Trap if they don't pay the cost and some Tzimi's can play Thoughts
Betrayed at superior.
You could also just strike for one at close, draw out the dodge/SCE and
aggravate it with Chiropteran Marauder if they just strike hands for
one.

Messages.Author: Santi Jean-Pierre
Messages.Body:
Thanks,

I've heard about this Skin Trap card. Nifty. Alas I've got none :(.
I don't play with Thaumaturgy or Domination so Theft of Vitae or Thoughts
Betrayed (a terrific and terrible card) aren't an option to me. Anyway,
Dragos doesn't spend any blood to use his combat cards and I've got two
racks in my library, a good addition to my intercept game.

I thought about using Primal Instinct with both aggravated damage and Meld
with Land. The first combo is clear: you aggravate the damage only after
your foe has elected not to dodge your one point strike ; as for the second,
Meld with Land would allow me to protect my Tzimisce in case things go awry
or to fool a combat end deck by playing the card first and then cancelling
it to strike while the opponent didn't use any combat ends strike, thinking
the combat is already over.
